name.zh: eSIM Plus 爱沙尼亚号码

tagline.en: Global eSIM marketplace — its global plan bundles an Estonian number (12 months, plan 365 days) with free SMS receiving
tagline.zh: 全球eSIM市场——全球套餐自带爱沙尼亚号码（号码12个月/套餐365天），免费收短信

description.en: eSIM Plus (esimplus.me) is a global eSIM marketplace; its Global plan ships with an Estonian phone number and free SMS receiving; per official terms the plan runs 365 days and the Estonian number is provided for 12 months — renew to keep the number. Pay by Visa/Mastercard or Google Pay; the QR code arrives in your order page. No real-name registration.
description.zh: eSIM Plus（esimplus.me）是全球eSIM交易平台；其全球套餐自带爱沙尼亚电话号码、免费收短信；按官方条款，套餐有效期365天、爱沙尼亚号码提供12个月——续购即可保留号码。支持Visa/Mastercard与Google Pay支付，二维码在订单页获取。无需实名。

details.en:
eSIM Plus is an aggregator rather than a carrier: its Estonia-numbered global plan is the low-maintenance option in this catalogue — SMS receiving is free and there is no keep-alive top-up ritual within a cycle (contrast giffgaff's 180-day rule or Moldtelecom's 6-month top-up); per official 2026-09 copy, the plan is valid 365 days and the Estonian number is provided for 12 months, so renew annually to keep the number (entry tier $7.99, up to $230).

Purchase flow per the 2025-09 source review: create an account with email, choose the global plan (which includes the Estonian number), pay by Visa/Mastercard/Google Pay, wait 2–3 minutes for confirmation, then fetch the number and eSIM QR code from the orders page.

Activation: native-eSIM phones scan the QR directly; others use an eSIM chip (e.g. Xesim) via the app's +/scan flow, about two minutes to load.

In mainland China the number roams with signal and SMS reception was verified working.

Caveats: this is a marketplace product — the underlying number's long-term fate depends on eSIM Plus's carrier arrangements, not a national carrier's retail arm; outbound calls/SMS and data are priced as add-ons; and the earlier 'permanent' framing overstated the terms — official copy ties the number to 12 months and the plan to one year.
details.zh:
eSIM Plus是聚合平台而非运营商：其带爱沙尼亚号码的全球套餐是本目录中的「低维护」选项——收短信免费、一个周期内不需要保号充值仪式（对比giffgaff的180天规则或Moldtelecom的6个月充值）；按2026-09官方文案，套餐有效期365天、爱沙尼亚号码提供12个月，需每年续购保留号码（入门档7.99美元，最高230美元）。

购买流程（2025-09源测评）：邮箱注册账号、选择全球套餐（自带爱沙尼亚号码）、Visa/Mastercard/Google Pay支付、等2-3分钟确认，随后在订单页查看号码与eSIM二维码。

激活：原生eSIM手机直接扫码；其他手机用eSIM芯片（如Xesim）经App的+/扫码流程写入，约两分钟加载完成。

在中国大陆漫游有信号，实测可正常收短信。

注意：这是平台产品——号码的长期存续取决于eSIM Plus与上游运营商的协议，而非国家级运营商的零售业务；通话/发短信与流量按叠加包计价；此前「永久」的表述高于官方条款——官方文案为号码12个月、套餐一年。

bestFor.en: Low-maintenance SMS receiving: one purchase covers 365 days, no top-up schedule.
bestFor.zh: 低维护收短信：一次购买覆盖365天，不需要按日历小额充值。

Free SMS receiving; works roaming in mainland China
zh: 全球套餐自带爱沙尼亚号码
套餐365天；号码12个月——续购保留，无需额外充值保号

name.zh: 全球套餐（爱沙尼亚号码）

validity.en: 365 days; Estonian number valid 12 months (renew to keep)
validity.zh: 365天；爱沙尼亚号码12个月（续购可保留）

plansNote.en: Plan tiers per esimplus.me/esim-global rendered 2026-09-16: $7.99 / $11.5 / $23 / $57.5 / $115 / $230, all 365 days, entry = 112 countries. Official copy: the Estonian number is provided for 12 months with the worldwide plan; renew to keep the number. The earlier 'permanent, no expiry' framing overstated the official terms.
plansNote.zh: 套餐档位按 esimplus.me/esim-global（2026-09-16渲染核验）：$7.99 / $11.5 / $23 / $57.5 / $115 / $230，均365天，入门档覆盖112国。官方文案：购全球套餐附带爱沙尼亚号码12个月；续购可保留号码。此前「永久无到期」的表述高于官方条款。

en: No keep-alive top-ups within a cycle — just renew the 365-day plan to keep the number
Free SMS receiving with an EU (Estonian) +372 number
QR code and number retrievable from the order page
zh: 周期内无需任何保号充值——到期续购365天套餐即保留号码
免费收短信，号码为欧盟（爱沙尼亚）+372
除银行卡外还支持Google Pay
二维码与号码在订单页随时可取

en: Marketplace product — number's fate tied to eSIM Plus's carrier deals
Calls, outgoing SMS and data are extra-cost add-ons
Requires an account (email login) unlike anonymous carrier checkouts
Number is valid 12 months per official terms — annual renewal needed (earlier 'permanent' framing overstated it)
zh: 平台产品——号码存续取决于eSIM Plus的上游运营商协议
通话、发短信与流量均为额外计费叠加包
需邮箱注册账号，不像运营商官网可匿名下单
官方条款为号码12个月——需每年续购（此前「永久」表述偏高）
